title: Two-hand Coordination
description: Add a left-hand bass note under the right-hand chord.

lessons.title: Left Hand Anchors
lessons.subtitle: One note on beat 1 — that's it.
lessons.complete: Great! You added a left-hand root note. That's the foundation of every pop song. 30 XP earned.

segments.text: Right hand plays the chord. Left hand plays one note: the root.
Same C, lower octave. Watch how it grounds the whole sound.

segments.prompt: Play C3 with your left hand and C-E-G with your right.
